header.name: Basic Electronics

outcomes.label: CO1
outcomes.raw_text: The students will be able to describe ideal circuit elements and basic non-idealities and their circuit representation.

outcomes.label: CO2
outcomes.raw_text: The students will be able to explain and analyze Kirchoff’s Laws and Network Theorems and their Applications.

outcomes.label: CO3
outcomes.raw_text: The students will be able to explain response of RC, RL and RLC circuits under transient (Step Response) and steady state conditions (both DC and Sinusoidal excitation).

outcomes.label: CO4
outcomes.raw_text: The students will be able to classify various Operational Amplifier configurations and implement OpAmp based circuits.

outcomes.label: CO5
outcomes.raw_text: The students will be able to classify Diodes, explain diode operation and implement diode-based rectifier and filter circuits.

lecture_topics: Basic components of Electrical Circuits: Fundamental Electrical variables – charge, current, voltage and power
independent and dependent voltage and current sources
Ideal circuit elements – Resistor, Capacitor and Inductor
weekly_plan.tutorial_assignment: Lab experiments on use of oscilloscope

lecture_topics: Basic concepts of Analysis of Resistive Networks: Nodes, Paths and Loops
Series and Parallel connection of Resistances and division voltage and current
weekly_plan.tutorial_assignment: Lab experiments on use of oscilloscope

lecture_topics: Network Theorems: Thevenin’s Theorem, Norton’s Theorem
weekly_plan.tutorial_assignment: Experiments and assignment problems in Kirchoff’s Laws and Loop and Node Analysis.
Assignments on Network Theorems and Applications

lecture_topics: RC and RL circuits’ response to Step and Direct input
weekly_plan.tutorial_assignment: Assignments and experiments on Network Theorems and Applications.

lecture_topics: RLC circuits’ response to Step and Direct input
weekly_plan.tutorial_assignment: Asignments and experiments on RL, RC circuits.
Asignments and experiments on RLC circuits.

lecture_topics: RC, RL and RLC circuits’ response to Alternating inputs (the response to alternating input will be handled only under steady state condition)
weekly_plan.tutorial_assignment: Asignments and experiments on RLC circuits
Assignments and experiments on the use of Operational Amplifier

lecture_topics: Operational Amplifier – Non-Inverting, Integrating and Differentiating configuration (explain virtual ground concept in the process and introduce the term feedback)
weekly_plan.tutorial_assignment: Assignments and experiments on the use of Operational Amplifiers
Assignments and experiments on clipper, clamper circuits
Assignments and Experiments on Diode applications

lecture_topics: Half Wave and Full Wave Rectifiers – Wave form and Ripple & its reduction. (8)
weekly_plan.tutorial_assignment: Assignments and Experiments on Diode Rectifiers and filters
